Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Claimed that a balanced net force can cause acceleration and that motion begins with a “balanced” horizontal force; this contradicts Newton’s laws. An object starts sliding only when an unbalanced force overcomes static friction. The planner also prematurely declared completion instead of selecting a specialist as instructed.
